product_context.problem_statement: Fleet safety operators need a timely, evidence-rich way to detect when a developmental autonomous vehicle is outside its approved operating design domain.
product_context.value_hypothesis: Earlier, explainable safety escalations will reduce unsafe autonomous driving exposure while keeping only reviewed vehicles available for supervised test routes.
in_scope: Decision support for pause, manual-takeover, and incident escalation on pre-approved test routes
non_goals: Vehicle steering, braking, or route selection
Replacing the safety driver's legal responsibility
product_context.user_journey_moment: During supervised public-road testing, immediately before or during an ODD, perception, or driver-attention alert.
product_context.fallback_experience: The system removes its recommendation, alerts the operator and safety driver to pause testing, and routes the event to the safety desk; the vehicle continues only after a human safety lead records approval.

system_profile.purpose: Surface safety-relevant evidence to help authorized humans pause an AV test before a collision or unsafe continued operation.
system_profile.decision_impact: A recommendation can cause a human to pause a public-road test; failure to escalate can expose pedestrians, cyclists, passengers, and road users to injury.
data_types: Safety-driver attention events; no raw biometric retention
system_profile.deployment_context: A limited, daylight, supervised test fleet on named routes in Vietnam; no passenger service and no driverless deployment.

system_boundary.model: Rule-assisted risk-ranking model with calibrated confidence thresholds
system_boundary.application: Operator console that displays alerts, evidence, and a pause recommendation

industry_risk_snapshot.rationale: A mistaken or delayed escalation during public-road testing can contribute to serious injury or death and may be hard to reverse. The limited pilot constrains scale, but pedestrians and other non-customers cannot opt out. Telemetry and camera-derived data require controls, while the NTSB Tempe report shows that operator attention and safety governance matter alongside the automated system.

vietnam.rationale: The pilot processes vehicle and potentially personal data in Vietnam and is safety-critical, but this pack does not establish all transport approvals, controller roles, or cross-border processing facts. Legal and privacy review is therefore required before any public-road pilot.

eu.rationale: If the system were placed on the EU market as an AI safety component of a regulated vehicle product, Article 6 of the EU AI Act is relevant. This is an anticipated-market assessment, not a compliance conclusion.

legal_classification.other_markets: No market assessment is made beyond Vietnam and a prospective EU comparison; expansion requires a jurisdiction-specific review.

product_metrics.success_kpi: For each approved test week, at least 95% of safety-relevant alerts receive a documented human disposition within five minutes.
product_metrics.risk_kri: Weekly rate of high-severity near-miss or missed-escalation investigations is at most 1 per 1,000 supervised test kilometers.
product_metrics.guardrail_metric: Hard stop: 0 autonomous test kilometers after a confirmed ODD breach, critical sensor fault, or unavailable human safety operator.
product_metrics.review_cadence: Safety review weekly and before each route expansion; re-review immediately after any collision, threshold breach, vendor/model/sensor change, or market change.

release_blockers: GAP-01: ODD and manual-takeover safety case is not accepted
GAP-02: Independent scenario and alert-burden evaluation is incomplete
GAP-03: Vietnam legal, privacy, and incident-governance gate is open
release_conditions: Use only synthetic or de-identified telemetry in research
No public-road pilot until each blocker is done and the Chief Safety Officer accepts residual risk
release_decision.next_review_trigger: 2026-10-15, any collision or near-miss investigation, a guardrail breach, or a material vehicle, sensor, vendor, route, or market change.
release_decision.residual_risk_rationale: Even with a human in the loop, delayed or poorly understood alerts can create automation complacency and expose non-consenting road users to physical harm. Research-only is appropriate until the safety case, operator authority, and independent evidence are complete.
